title: Overnight Door Activity vs Geofence Alerts
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:geofence door_zone=* overnight_alert=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(overnight_alert="yes",1,0))) as matched by door_zone
| eval an_overnight_alert_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_overnight_alert_pct
description: Measures the percentage of overnight movement intervals that end with an overnight alert by door zone.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which door zone are helping or hurting overnight movement intervals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an overnight alert` on `care:geofence` events and summarize the hit rate by `door_zone`.
visualization: Table of door zone with percentage of overnight movement intervals ending with an overnight alert.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often an overnight alert happens for each door zone so you can see where overnight movement intervals go smoothly or get stuck.
